alpha.selection_rationale: Torpedo saturation core: two torpedo cruisers (4 launchers each) plus a fast corvette deliver 16+ torpedo rounds in coordinated volleys to overwhelm point defense. A battleship and two destroyers form the gun line to hammer targets in the mid-range bracket, while the frigate and the cruisers' 4-PD turrets anchor a defensive wall that shaves incoming coilgun slugs and blinds enemy seekers.
alpha.formation_rationale: Battleship takes point as a durable vanguard tank, with destroyers, corvette, and frigate clustered within ~100 km to form an overlapping point-defense screen against incoming torpedoes. The two fragile torpedo cruisers are held back at -x, protected behind the PD wall and kept out of the enemy's immediate gun exchange so they can launch torpedoes from relative safety.

beta.selection_rationale: Fast corvette torpedo swarm (24 torps) saturates enemy PD early while destroyers and battlecruisers close to sub-300km for accurate coilgun fire, with a battleship anchoring the line as a heavy-armor gun platform. This mixes speed, saturation, and firepower to overwhelm a simple AI captain's point-defense allocation.
beta.formation_rationale: Corvettes form a fast forward picket to absorb the first exchange and screen for torpedoes/spot enemy fire. Destroyers sit just behind them, close enough (~30-40km) to overlap PD coverage with the corvette line. Battlecruisers flank wide and slightly elevated to open alternate firing angles against enemy spinal weapons while staying within PD-support range of the destroyers. Sovereign, the fleet's main strength, is held in reserve at the rear-center, shielded by the layered screen ahead while still close enough (~50-70km) to the battlecruisers for mutual PD support.
